# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(APCalign)
library(terra) # used to extract and process rasters
library(tictoc) # used to track time processes take

# For climate medoids
library(arrow)
library(sf)
library(ozmaps)
library(furrr)

```

# Datasets

Reusing data from Cornsters annuals project. To save duplicating that, I'm just going to create a symbolic link to those datasets, to those directories. 

```
ln -s ../Cornsters-australian_annuals/data data
ln -s ../Cornsters-australian_annuals/downloads downloads 
```

## Get climate covariates

Load climate covariates from worldclim

- BIO_1: "Annual Mean Temperature" — the average temperature (°C) over the year for a location.
- BIO_12 is a bioclimatic variable representing "Annual Precipitation." 

```{r}
vars <- c("wc2.1_2.5m_bio_1.tif", "wc2.1_2.5m_bio_12.tif")

# Australia
australia <- terra::rast("data/australia.tif")

# Stacked raster of climate predictors, cropped to Australia
stacked_rasters <-
  # list.files(wc_path, full.names = TRUE, pattern = ".bil") |>
  file.path("data/climate", vars) |>
  terra::rast() |>
  terra::crop(australia)
```


## GBIF

Load cleaned GBIF/ALA dataset as tibble, create a dataset spanning known species obervations, link to climate layers

```{r}
output <- "data-processed/gbif_data_climates.parquet"

if (!file.exists(output)) {
  data_gbif <- arrow::read_parquet("data/GBIF/2025/GBIF_aus_clean_0001494-250914085247600.parquet") |>
    janitor::clean_names()

  data_gbif_vect <-
    data_gbif |>
    terra::vect(
      geom = c("decimal_longitude", "decimal_latitude"),
      crs = terra::crs(stacked_rasters)
    )

  data_gbif_climate <-
    terra::extract(x = stacked_rasters, y = data_gbif_vect, method = "simple", xy = TRUE, ID = FALSE, dataframe = TRUE) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    select(x, y, everything())

  # fixing taxonomy in GBIF
  aligned_species_list <- arrow::read_parquet("data/GBIF/2025/gbif_names_aligned_2025.parquet")

  data_gbif_cleaned <-
    data_gbif |>
    rename(original_name = species) |>
    select(-taxon_rank) |>
    left_join(by = "original_name", aligned_species_list) |>
    bind_cols(data_gbif_climate |> select(-x, -y)) |>
    select(original_name, taxon_name = accepted_name, genus, scientific_name, starts_with("decimal"), annual_precipitation = wc2.1_2.5m_bio_12, average_temperature = wc2.1_2.5m_bio_1, everything()) |>
    # Rogue points to remove
    filter(!is.na(annual_precipitation), !is.na(average_temperature), annual_precipitation > 0) |>
    filter(
      !(decimal_longitude == 134.1 & decimal_latitude == -25.7)
    ) |>
    mutate(
      log_annual_precipitation = log(annual_precipitation),
      log_annual_precipitation_centered = (log_annual_precipitation - mean(log_annual_precipitation)) / sd(log_annual_precipitation),
      average_temperature_centered = (average_temperature - mean(average_temperature)) / sd(average_temperature),
    ) |>
    relocate(contains("_centered"), .after = "average_temperature")

  arrow::write_parquet(data_gbif_cleaned, output)
}

data_gbif_cleaned <- arrow::read_parquet(output)
```

### Climate centres

Calculating the centre of @D distribtion (medoid)

```{r}
output <- "data-processed/data_spp_climates-medoid.parquet"

if (!file.exists(output)) {

  source("R/locate_medoid_2d.R")

  # Example for a species
  taxon <- "Daviesia latifolia"
  process_taxon_medoid(taxon, overwrite = TRUE)

  # Deploy for lot of species
  output_dir <- "~/Downloads/climate_centres/"
  file.path(output_dir, "data") |> dir.create(showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  file.path(output_dir, "figures") |> dir.create(showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  taxa <-  arrow::open_dataset("data-processed/data_gbif_cleaned.parquet") |>
    select(taxon_name, genus) |>
    distinct() |>
    collect() |>
    filter(!is.na(taxon_name)) |>
    filter(!taxon_name|> str_detect("/"))

  ncores <- parallel::detectCores() - 2
  options(mc.cores = ncores)
  plan(multisession, workers = ncores)
  taxa$taxon_name |>
  #  future_walk(~ process_taxon_medoid(.x, overwrite = FALSE))
    walk(~ process_taxon_medoid(.x, overwrite = FALSE))

  # Now compile for all the species
  read_taxon <- function(taxon) {
      file.path(output_dir, "data", paste0(taxon, ".rds")) |> readRDS()
  }

  data_spp_medoids <- taxa$taxon_name |> furrr::future_map(read_taxon) |> bind_rows()

  data_spp_medoids |> arrow::write_parquet(output)
}

```

Alternatively: A simple calculation (not used)

```{r, eval = FALSE}
output <- "data-processed/data_spp_climates-simple.parquet"

if (!file.exists(output)) {
  data_spp_climates <-
    data_gbif_cleaned |>
    group_by(taxon_name, genus, scientific_name) |>
    summarize(
      n = n(),
      across(where(is.numeric), list(
        p50 = ~ quantile(.x, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
        p05 = ~ quantile(.x, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
        p95 = ~ quantile(.x, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
      ), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    arrange(taxon_name) |>
    mutate(
      decimal_longitude_range = decimal_longitude_p95 - decimal_longitude_p05,
      decimal_latitude_range = decimal_latitude_p95 - decimal_latitude_p05,
      average_temperature_range = average_temperature_p95 - average_temperature_p05,
      annual_precipitation_range = annual_precipitation_p95 / annual_precipitation_p05
    )

  arrow::write_parquet(data_spp_climates, "data-processed/data_spp_climates-simple.parquet")
}
```


## AusTraits

```{r}
traits <- c(
  "leaf_mass_per_area", "leaf_area", "leaf_N_per_dry_mass",
  "leaf_N_per_area", "leaf_P_per_area",
  "seed_dry_mass", "wood_density", "leaf_P_per_dry_mass", "leaf_delta13C"
)

output <- "data-processed/austraits_geo_climates.parquet"

if (!file.exists(output)) {
  austraits <- readRDS("data/austraits/austraits-7.0.0.rds") |>
    austraits::flatten_database()

  austraits_geo <-
    austraits |>
    filter(
      trait_name %in% traits,
      basis_of_record == "field",
      !is.na(`latitude (deg)`), !is.na(`longitude (deg)`)
    ) |>
    mutate(across(c("latitude (deg)", "longitude (deg)", value), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)))) |>
    # Remove problematic values
    filter(
      !is.na(`latitude (deg)`), !is.na(`longitude (deg)`),
      !(trait_name == "leaf_delta13C" & value < 20)
    )

  # Add climate data
  trait_data_vect <-
    austraits_geo |>
    select("longitude (deg)", "latitude (deg)") |>
    terra::vect(
      geom = c("longitude (deg)", "latitude (deg)"),
      crs = terra::crs(stacked_rasters)
    )

  data_traits_climate <-
    terra::extract(x = stacked_rasters, y = trait_data_vect, method = "simple", bind = TRUE, xy = FALSE, cells = FALSE, ID = FALSE, dataframe = TRUE) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    bind_cols(austraits_geo) |>
    rename(decimal_longitude = `longitude (deg)`, decimal_latitude = `latitude (deg)`, annual_precipitation = wc2.1_2.5m_bio_12, average_temperature = wc2.1_2.5m_bio_1) |>
    select(decimal_longitude, decimal_latitude, annual_precipitation, average_temperature, everything())

  arrow::write_parquet(data_traits_climate, "data-processed/data_traits_climate.parquet")
}

```
